summary: Confirmed the defect: skill_orchestrate_mint_dispatch_seq (scripts/skill-base.sh) increments an ambient shell variable rather than reading dispatch_seq_counter from the loop guard file, so a fresh-shell call (the normal per-Bash-tool-call execution shape) always re-mints 1. Fix: adopt the jq -r '(.dispatch_seq_counter // 0) + 1' idiom already used correctly at Stage MT-4. Both engines share one function via an identical named-shim, so one fix covers both. No existing test exercises the mint function itself.

artifacts.summary: Root-cause confirmation, recommended fix, and test-coverage gap analysis for the dispatch_seq minting defect.
